update.name: openSUSE-build-key
update.summary: The public gpg keys for rpm package signature verification
update.description: This package contains the gpg keys that are used to sign the openSUSE rpm packages. The keys installed here are not actually used by anything. rpm/zypper use the keys in the rpm db instead.

update.name: update-test-reboot-needed
update.summary: Test update that requires a system reboot
update.description:
Package for testing the update stack during product development.
An update for this package should inform the user that a system reboot is necessary. This is used, for example, in kernel updates.

update.name: update-test-security
update.summary: Test update that includes security fixes
update.description:
Package for testing the update stack during product development.
An update for this package should have its category set to "security", indicating that one or more security vulnerabilities are being fixed.
